channel.title: Power Station on Solarhub Help Center
channel.description: Recent content in Power Station on Solarhub Help Center

item.title: Create a power plant
item.description: Creation method 1 link Steps link Click the plus sign in the upper right corner of the power plant list to enter the power plant creation interface After adding the power plant information, click the save button in the upper right corner to create successfully Creation method 2 link Steps link Click on the power station in the power station list to enter the power station overview interface Click Create Power Station in the upper right corner menu After adding the power station information, click the Save button in the upper right corner to create successfully

item.title: Search or filter power stations
item.description: 1. Power station search link Under “Power Station” of the APP, you can search for power stations by power station name keywords 2. Power station screening link Two conditions for filtering link Filter by power plant type Filter by power plant online status

item.title: Add a collector
item.description: Steps link Select a power station in the power station list to enter the power station overview page Click Add Collector in the upper right corner of the power station overview page Scan the code or click the keyboard icon to enter the manual input interface Manually enter the collector SN number and click Add Device

item.title: Switch power plant
item.description: Steps link Select a power plant in the power plant list to enter the power plant overview page Click Switch Power Plant in the upper right corner of the power plant overview page to enter the switch power plant interface Select the power plant to switch to complete the switch

item.title: Power plant history
item.description: Steps link Select a power station in the power station list to enter the power station overview interface Select History at the bottom to enter the history interface You can view the data at a certain time point by pressing the chart You can switch the historical data of the previous day or the next day by using the arrow above, and click the time to manually select the time

item.title: Power Plant Layout
item.description: 1. Create layout link Steps link Select a power plant in the power plant list to enter the power plant overview interface Select Layout at the bottom to enter the layout interface Create a layout By default, corresponding components will be created based on all devices under the power plant 2. Edit layout link Steps link You can freely adjust the position of components by dragging them or edit them individually through the edit below
